mapper.sql: FROM TB_LMS_DEPT A JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = A.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT UP ON UP.DEPT_ID = A.UP_DEPT_ID
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.listUserMgrDeptCode 설 명 : 학과/부서 상위 코드 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.ORG_ID , A.DEPT_ID , A.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT A WHERE A.ORG_ID = #{orgId} ORDER BY A.DEPTNM

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.selectUserMgrDept 설 명 : 학과/부서 단건 조회 */ SELECT A.ORG_ID , ORG.ORGNM , A.DEPT_ID , A.UP_DEPT_ID , UP.DEPTNM AS upDeptnm , A.DEPTNM , A.DEPT_ENNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT A JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON ORG.ORG_ID = A.ORG_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT UP ON UP.DEPT_ID = A.UP_DEPT_ID WHERE A.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
AND A.ORG_ID = #{orgId}
/* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.countUserMgrDeptId 설 명 : 학과/부서 코드 중복 건수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_DEPT A WHERE A.DEPT_ID = #{deptId}
mapper.update: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.mergeUserMgrDeptHaksaSync 설 명 : 학사연동 뷰(VW_HAK_DEPT_INF) 기준 학과/부서 Upsert - 학사구분자는 TB_LMS_ORG.ORG_TYCD(= VW_HAK_DEPT_INF.UP_DEPT_ID)로 매핑 - 신규 코드 INSERT (UP_DEPT_ID/DEPT_ENNM 은 NULL) - 기존 코드 DEPTNM 갱신 (영문명/상위코드는 보존) - 미지원 기관(ORG_TYCD 미일치)은 대상 0건 → 정상 종료 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_DEPT D USING ( SELECT V.DEPT_ID , V.DEPTNM FROM VW_HAK_DEPT_INF V JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND V.UP_DEPT_ID = O.ORG_TYCD ) S ON (D.DEPT_ID = S.DEPT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET D.DEPTNM = S.DEPTNM , D.MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} , D.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DEPT_ID , ORG_ID , UP_DEPT_ID , DEPTNM , DEPT_ENNM , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM ) VALUES ( S.DEPT_ID , #{orgId} , NULL , S.DEPTNM , NULL , #{rgtrId} , FN_DTTM() , #{mdfrId} , FN_DTTM() )
mapper.select: /* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.countHaksaSyncAdd 설 명 : 학사연동 신규(INSERT) 대상 건수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VW_HAK_DEPT_INF V JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND V.UP_DEPT_ID = O.ORG_TYCD WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_DEPT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = V.DEPT_ID )

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.countHaksaSyncMod 설 명 : 학사연동 수정(UPDATE) 대상 건수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VW_HAK_DEPT_INF V JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND V.UP_DEPT_ID = O.ORG_TYCD JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_ID = V.DEPT_ID

/* SQL ID : UserMgrDeptDAO.selectHaksaSyncStaleDeptIds 설 명 : 학사연동 삭제 대상 학과/부서 아이디 목록 */ SELECT D.DEPT_ID FROM TB_LMS_DEPT D WHERE D.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VW_HAK_DEPT_INF V JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND V.UP_DEPT_ID = O.ORG_TYCD ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM VW_HAK_DEPT_INF V JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND V.UP_DEPT_ID = O.ORG_TYCD WHERE V.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID )
